item.title: Family business wins battle to keep selling pizza from van outside South London church
item.description: A family business has won permission to keep selling pizza from a van outside a South London church, after concerns were raised its location was “disrespectful”. Kingston Council has granted Vesuvio on the Road a 12-month street trading licence to sell food and soft drinks from a van outside St Pius X Roman Catholic Church
